ध: ध The aspirated letter corresponding to the preceding, and expressed by Dh.
ध m. (धः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 A name of KUVERA. 3 Virtue, moral merit. n. (धं) Wealth, property. E. धा to have or possess, affix क.
धक्क: धक्क r. 10th cl. (धक्कयति) To destroy or annihilate.
धट: धट m. (-टः) 1 A balance, a pair of scales. 2 The sign Libra. 3 Ordeal by the balance. f. (-टी) 1 Old cloth or raiment. 2 A piece of cloth worn over the privities. E. धण to sound, and ट substituted for ण, affix अच्.
धटक: धटक m. (-कः) A weight of forty-two Rattis.
धटिनी: धटिनी f. (-नी) A cotton tie or string, fastened round the loins. E. धट a cloth, and इनि aff.
धटीदान: धटीदान n. (-नं) Giving old cloth to a woman after impregnation. E. धदी, and दान giving.
धत्तूर: धत्तूर m. (-रः) The thorn apple: see धुस्तर. E. धेट् to drink, उरच् affix, deriv. irr.
धन: धन r. 1st. cl. (धनति) To sound. r. 3rd cl. (दधन्ति) To bear or produce, (grain, &c.): restricted to the Vedas.

धन n. (-नं) 1 Property of any description, thing, substance, wealth. 2 Wealth in cattle, property in herds. 3 A term of endearment. 4 (In Algebra,) The affirmative quantity or plus. E. धन to produce, (a crop,) affix अच्.
धनकेलि: धनकेलि m. (-लिः) KUVERA, the Hindū Plutus; also धनकेलिक. E. धन wealth, and केलि who sports.
धनगर्वित: धनगर्व्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purseproud. E. धन, and गर्व्वित arrogant.
धनगर्व्वित: धनगर्व्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purseproud. E. धन, and गर्व्वित arrogant.
धनच्छू: धनच्छू f. (-च्छूः) The Numidian crane. E. धन the wealth, (of fields,) and च्छो to destroy, affix डू. Note; as a synonym of करेटव्या this word would seem to mean the bird stated: the name itself is more analogous to the Dhanesa of the dialects or the Indian Buceros.
धनजात: धनजात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Springing from wealth. E. धन, and जात born.
धनञ्जय: धनञ्जय m. (-यः) 1 The deity of fire. 2 A name of ARJUNA. 3 One of the Nāgas or infernal serpents. 4 One of the five vital airs, that which is supposed to fatten. 5 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) E. धन wealth, जि to conquer or possess, affix खञ्.
धनतृष्णा: धनतृष्णा f. (-ष्णा) Covetousness. E. धन, and तृष्णा thirst.
धनद: धनद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Beneficent, liberal, who gives away property, &c. m. (-दः) A name of KUVERA. E. धन wealth, देङ् to drink, or दा to give, affix क.
धनदण्ड: धनदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Fine, amercement. E. धन, and दण्ड punishment.
धनदर्प: धनदर्प m. (-र्पः) Pride of wealth. E. धन, and दर्प pride.
धनदानुज: धनदानुज m. (-जः) RĀVAṆA. E. धनद KUVERA, and अनुज younger brother.
धनदायिन्: धनदायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Liberal, munificent. m. (-यी) 1 The deity of fire. 2 A benefactor, a donor. E. धन wealth, दा to give, णिनि aff.
धनन्ददा: धनन्ददा f. (-दा) One of the Śaktis, or female personifications of divine power peculiar to the Bauddhas. E. धन wealth, दद to give, affix खश्.
धनपति: धनपति m. (-तिः) The god of riches, KUVERA. E. धन wealth, and पति master or lord.
धनपिशाचिका: धनपिशाचिका f. (-का) Avarice, thirst of wealth. E. धन wealth, पिशाचा a she-demon, affix कन्.
धनपिशाची: धनपिशाची f. (-ची) Extreme desire of riches, avarice. E. see the preceding.
धनप्रिय: धनप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fond of wealth. f. (-या) A vegetable, (Ardisia solanacea.) E. धन, and प्रिय dear to.
धनमद: धनमद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Proud, inflated with the pride of wealth. E. धन wealth, मद to be intoxicated, affix अप्.
धनमूल: धनमूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Proceeding from wealth. n. (-लं) Principal, capital. E. धन, and मूल root.
धनलुब्ध: धनलुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Miserly, avaricious, greedy of wealth, mercenary. E. धन, and लुब्ध desirous.
धनलोभ: धनलोभ m. (-भः) Desire of wealth, greediness, avarice. E. धन, and लोभ desire.
धनवत्: धनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wealthy, opulent. f. (-वती) The constellation Dhaniṣṭha. E. धन wealth, and मतुप् possessive aff.
धनव्यय: धनव्यय m. (-यः) Expenditure, extravagance. E. धन, and व्यय expense.
धनसम्पत्ति: धनसम्पत्ति f. (-त्तिः) Accumulation of wealth. E. धन, and सम्पत्ति acquirement.
धनस्यक: धनस्यक m. (-कः) A plant: see गोक्षुर.
धनहर: धनहर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Inheriting, an heir. 2 Stealing, a thief. 3 Taking wealth, &c. f. (-री) A sort of perfume, commonly called Cor. E. धन wealth, हृ to steal, affix अप्, or टच्.
धनहरिन्: धनहरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) A thief, a pilferer. E. see the last.
धनहारिन्: धनहारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Inheriting, an heir. 2 A thief. E. धन, and हारिन् who takes.
धनहीन: धनहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Poor, reduced to poverty. E. धन, and हीन deprived of.
धनागम: धनागम m. (-मः) Accession of wealth. E. धन, and आगम coming.
धनादान: धनादान n. (-नं) Acceptance of money. E. धन, and आदान taking.
धनाधिकारिन्: धनाधिकारिन् mf. (-री-रिणी) An heir, an heiress. m. (-रिः) A treasurer, a collector. E. धन, and अधिकारिन् having a right to.
धनाधिकृत: धनाधिकृत m. (-तः) A treasurer. E. धन, and अधिकृत placed over.
धनाधिप: धनाधिप m. (-पः) 1 A name of KUVERA. 2 A treasurer. E. धन riches, and अधिप lord; also similar compounds, धनाधिपति, &c.
धनाध्यक्ष: धनाध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A name of KUVERA. 2 A treasurer. E. धन wealth, अध्यक्ष superintendent.
धनापहार: धनापहार m. (-रः) 1 Fine, amercement. 2 Plunder. E. धन, and अपहार taking away.
धनार्चित: धनार्च्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wealthy, opulent. E. धन, and अर्च्चित respected by.
धनार्च्चित: धनार्च्चित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Wealthy, opulent. E. धन, and अर्च्चित respected by.
धनार्जन: धनार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquisition of property. E. धन, and अर्ज्जन acquiring.
धनार्ज्जन: धनार्ज्जन n. (-नं) Acquisition of property. E. धन, and अर्ज्जन acquiring.
धनार्थिन्: धनार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Seeking for wealth, covetous, miserly. E. धन, and अर्थिन् who wants.
धनाशा: धनाशा f. (-शा) Thirst of wealth, longing after riches. E. धन wealth, आशा hope, wish.
धनाश्री: धनाश्री f. (-श्रीः) One of the Rāgiṇīs.
धनिक: धनिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Pious, virtuous, excellent. 2 Rich, opulent. m. (-कः) 1 A wealthy man. 2 A creditor. 3 A husband. 4 Coriander. f. (-का) 1 A virtuous or excellent woman. 2 A wife. 3 A young woman. 4 A tree: see प्रियङ्गु. E. धन wealth, affix ठक्.
धनिन्: धनिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Wealthy, opulent. m. (-नी) 1 A rich man. 2 A creditor. E. धन wealth, इनि aff.
धनिष्ठा: धनिष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) The twenty-fourth Nakṣatra or lunar mansion; it comprises four stars, apparently α β γ and δ Delphini, and is figured by a drum or tabor. E. धन to produce, (as corn,) affix अच् and मतुप् added, धनवत् again, इष्ठन् added, and मतुप् rejected, fem. affix टाप्.
धनीका: धनीका f. (-का) A young woman. E. धन wealth, ठक् affix, and the vowel made long.
धनीयक: धनीयक n. (-कं) Coriander seed. E. धन to be produced, (as corn,) affix छ, and कन् added: see धन्याक.
धनु: धनु m. (-नुः) 1 A bow. 2 The sign Sagittarius. 3 A tree: see प्रियाल. 4 A measure of four cubits. E. धन here meaning to cast as an arrow, Uṇādi affix उ; also धनुस्.
धनुःकाण्ड: धनुःकाण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A bow and arrow. E. धनुस्, and काण्ड an arrow.
धनुःखण्ड: धनुःखण्ड n. (-ण्डं) A bow, the stick or horns of the bow. E. धनुस्, and खण्ड a part.
धनुःपट: धनुःपट m. (-टः) The Piyal tree, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) E. धनुस् a bow, and पट width; bending like a bow.
धनुःशाखा: धनुःशाखा f. (-खा) A plant, from the leaves of which a tough thread is extracted, of which bow strings were formerly made: see मूर्व्वा, (Sanseviera zeylanica, Rox. but called by Sir WM. JONES, Aletris hyacinthoides.) E. धनुस् a bow, शाखा a branch.
धनुःश्रेणी: धनुःश्रेणी f. (-णी) A plant: see the last. E. धनुस् a bow, and श्रेणी a line.
धनुर्गुण: धनुर्गुण mf. (-णः-णा) A bow string. f. (-णा) A plant, from which bow strings are made: see the two last. E. धनुस् a bow, and गुण a string.
धनुर्द्रुम: धनुर्द्रुम m. (-मः) A bambu. E. धनुस्, and द्रुम a tree.
धनुर्धर: धनुर्धर m. (-रः) An archer, a bowyer, one armed with a bow. E. धनुस् a bow, and धर who possesses.
धनुर्धारिन्: धनुर्धारिन् m. (-री) An archer, a bowyer. E. धनुस्, and धारिन् who has.
धनुर्भृत्: धनुर्भृत् m. (-त्) An archer. E. धनुस् a bow, and भृत् who possesses: see the last.
धनुर्मध्य: धनुर्म्मध्य n. (-ध्यं) The middle part of a bow. E. धनुस् a bow, मध्य the centre.
धनुर्म्मध्य: धनुर्म्मध्य n. (-ध्यं) The middle part of a bow. E. धनुस् a bow, मध्य the centre.
धनुर्मार्ग: धनुर्म्मार्ग n. (-र्गं) A curve line. E. धनुस् an are, and मार्ग a road.
धनुर्म्मार्ग: धनुर्म्मार्ग n. (-र्गं) A curve line. E. धनुस् an are, and मार्ग a road.
धनुर्माला: धनुर्म्माला f. (-ला) A plant, from the leaves of which bow strings were made: see मूर्व्वा. E. धनुस् a bow, and माला a garland.
धनुर्म्माला: धनुर्म्माला f. (-ला) A plant, from the leaves of which bow strings were made: see मूर्व्वा. E. धनुस् a bow, and माला a garland.
धनुर्यास: धनुर्य्यास m. (-सः) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. धनुस् for धन्वन् a dry soil, and यास here said to mean effort; also धन्वयास.
धनुर्य्यास: धनुर्य्यास m. (-सः) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. धनुस् for धन्वन् a dry soil, and यास here said to mean effort; also धन्वयास.
धनुर्वृक्ष: धनुर्वृक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A plant; also called Dhāminiya. 2 A bambu. 3 A measure of four cubits. 4 An are, a portion of the circumference of a circle. E. धनुस् a bow, and वृक्ष a tree.
धनुष्कर: धनुष्कर m. (-रः) A bowyer, an archer. E. धनुस् a bow, and कर who makes or practices.
धनुष्पट: धनुष्पट m. (-टः) A tree: see धनुःपट. E. धनुस् a bow, पट breadth.
धनुष्पाणि: धनुष्पाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) Armed with a bow. m. (-णिः) An archer. E. धमुस्, and पाणि hand.
धनुष्मत्: धनुष्मत् m. (-ष्मान्) An archer, a bowyer. E. धनुस् a bow, मतुप् aff.
धनुस्: धनुस् mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) Armed with a bow. mn. (-नुः-नु) 1 A bow. 2 Sagittarius, the sign. m. (-नुः) The Piyal tree, (Buchanania latifolia, Rox.) E. धन to produce, (as grain,) to throw forth, (darts, &c.) Uṇādi affix उसि; also with उ affix धनु, and with ऊ affix, धनू.
धनू: धनू m. (-नूः) A bow: see the last.
धनेयक: धनेयक n. (-कं) Coriander: see धन्याक. E. धन grain, ढक् affix, and कन् added.
धनेश: धनेश m. (-शः) KUVERA. E. धन, and ईश lord.
धनेश्वर: धनेश्वर m. (-रः) KUVERA, the Hindū PLUTUS. E. धन wealth, ईश्वर lord.
धनैषिन्: धनैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Wishing or claiming property. m. (-षी) A creditor. E. धन, and ऐषिन् who wishes.
धनोपचय: धनोपचय m. (-यः) Accumulation of wealth. E. धन, and उपचय assembling.
धन्य: धन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) 1 Fortunate, well fated, lucky. 2 Good, virtuous. m. (-न्यः) 1 An infidel, an atheist. 2 A virtuous or fortunate man. f. (-न्या) 1 Emblic myrobalan. 2 A nurse. 3 Coriander. n. (-न्यं) Wealth. E. धन to produce, (grain, &c.) or धन wealth, and यत् affix of fitness.
धन्यत्व: धन्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Luck, good fortune. E. धन्य, and त्व affix; also with तल् affix धन्यता.
धन्याक: धन्याक n. (-कं) A plant, bearing a small pungent seed used by the Hindus as a condiment, (Coriandrum sativum.) E. धन to produce, (as grain,) deriv. irr.
धन्व: धन्व n. (-न्वं) A bow: see धन्वन्.
धन्वदुर्ग: धन्वदुर्ग n. (-र्गं) A desart. E. धन्व the same, and दुर्ग strong, hold.
धन्वन्: धन्वन् mn. (-न्वा-न्व) A bow. m. (-न्वा) A country scantily supplied with water, a desart, a waste. n. (-न्व) A firm spot, land, ground. E. धन्वि Sautra root, to go or move, (by or on which,) and कनिन् Uṇādi affix; also with अच् affix धन्व.
धन्वन: धन्वन m. (-नः) A medicinal plant, commonly called Dhāminiya or Dhamin.
धन्वन्तरि: धन्वन्तरि m. (-रिः) 1 The physician of the gods, who was produced at the churning of the ocean. 2 A celebrated physician; also काशिराज being the same as the preceding in another existence: he appears to have been the founder of the Hindu medical school. 3 The sun. 4 A name of ŚIVA. 5 One of the nine gems of the court of VIKRAMĀDITYA.
धन्वन्तरिग्रस्ता: धन्वन्तरिग्रस्ता f. (-स्ता) A medicinal plant: see कटुकी. E. धन्वन्तारि, and ग्रस्त eaten.
धन्वयवास: धन्वयवास m. (-सः) A plant, (Hedysarum alhaji.) E. धन्व dry soil, यु to unite, आसच् affix; also with कन् added धन्वयवासक.
धन्वयास: धन्वयास m. (-सः) A plant: see the last; also simply यास, &c.
धन्विन्: धन्विन् m. (-न्वी) 1 An archer, a bow-man. 2 A name of ARJUNA. 3 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) 4 A wag, a wit, a sharp or shrewd man. E. धन्व a bow, इनि aff.
धम: धम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) One who blows a fire or a trumpet. m. (-मः) 1 A name of the moon. 2 KṚṢṆA. 3 A name of Yama. 4 BRAHMA, or the Supreme Spirit. E. ध्मा to blow, affix श.
धमक: धमक m. (-कः) A blacksmith. E. ध्मा to blow, (the forge,) कुन् Uṇādi aff.
धमधमा: धमधमा ind. Blowing reiteratedly, or the sort of sound made by blowing with a bellows or a trumpet.
धमन: धमन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 One who blows a bellows, a trumpet, &c. 2 Cruel. m. (-नः) 1 A reed, (Arundo tibialis or karka.) 2 Blowing, (a wind instrument.) f. (-निः or -नी) 1 Any tubular vessel of the body, as a vein, a nerve, &c. 2 The neck. 3 Turmerick. 4 A sort of perfume; also हट्टविलासिनी. E. धम from ध्मा, to blow, &c. affix युच्, fem. affix इन् or ङीष् or ध्मा as before, Uṇādi affix अनि, and ङीप् optionally added.
धम्मल: धम्मल m. (-लः) The breast ornamented with gold or jewels: see धम्मिल्ल.
धम्मिल्ल: धम्मिल्ल m. (-ल्लः) Braided and ornamented hair, tied round the head, and intermixed with flowers, pearls, &c. E. धम a Sautra root, to breathe, affix विच्, धम्; मिल to meet, लच् affix, and the two conjoined.
धय: धय mfn. (-यः-या-यी-यं) Who or what drinks. f. (-या) A little girl, female infant. E. घे to drink, affix श.
धर: धर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Who or what has or holds. m. (-रः) 1 A mountain. 2 A flock of cotton. 3 The tortoise Avatāra. 4 One of the demigods called VASUS. f. (-रा) 1 The earth. 2 The uterus or womb. 3 Marrow. 4 A vessel of the body. 5 A golden globe or heap of valuables, representing the earth, and given to Brahmans. E. धृञ् to have or hold, to contain or support, &c. affix अच्, or ट fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्.
धरण: धरण mn. (-णः-णं) 1 Holding, possessing, having. 2 A sort of measure, a weight of ten Palas. 3 A weight of silver, sixteen Māṣas. m. (-णः) 1 The Himāla mountain considered as king of mountains. 2 The sun. 3 A world. 4 A breast, a female breast. 5 Rice. 6 A ridge of land answering the purpose of a bridge, the edge of a river, the skirt of a mountain, a bridge. f. (-णी) 1 The earth. 2 The silk cotton tree. 3 A vessel of the body. 4 An esculent root. E. धृ to hold, to uphold or support, affix ल्युट्, fem. affix ङीप्.
धरणि: धरणि f. (-णिः) The earth. E. धृ to be contained, (animals, &c.) Uṇādi affix अणि; also धरणी as above.
धरणिधर: धरणिधर m. (-रः) A name of VIṢṆU. E. धरणि the earth, and धर who sustains; also धरणिधर.
धरणिस्थ: धरणिस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Being or staying on earth. E. धरणि, and स्थ what stays or is.
धरणीकन्द: धरणीकन्द m. (-न्दः) An esculent root or bulb. E. धरणी the earth, कन्द a root.
धरणीकीलक: धरणीकीलक m. (-कः) A mountain. E. धरणी the earth, कीलक a pin or bolt.
धरणीधर: धरणीधर m. (-रः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A mountain. 3 A tortoise: see धरणिधर.
धरणीपूर: धरणीपूर m. (-रः) The ocean. E. धरणी the earth, पूर to surround completely, affix अच्.

धा: धा (डु, ञ,) डुधाञ् r. 3rd cl. (दधाति धत्ते) 1 To hold or support. 2 To nurture, to maintain. 3 To give. 4 To have, to possess. With अनु and सम् prefixed, To search after. With अपि, To cover. With अभि, 1 To speak, to speak to or address. 2 To promulgate. 3 To show. With अभि and सम, To overcome. With अव, 1 To be careful. 2 To attend to. With आङ्, To take, to receive. With उप and आङ्, To support. With उप, 1 To uphold. 2 To do, to perform. With नि, 1 To take up or hold up. 2 To place in or upon. 3 To be born or produced. 4 To hold. With परि, To assume, to put on, as clothes, &c. With प्र and नि, 1 To hold or support. 2 To elevate or exalt, to dignify. 3 To admit. With प्र. 1 To be chief or first. 2 To send. With प्रति and वि, To do, to perform. With वि, 1 To do, to execute, to act. 3 To act conformably to religious ordinances, to execute the precepts of the Vedas. 3 To choose, to select. 4 To provide. 5 To order or direct. 6 To promise. 7 To give. With वि and अव, To hide, to veil, to conceal. With सम, 1 To place, to place firmly, to fix. 2 To unite, to combine, to hold together. 3 To shoot at a mark. With सम and प्र, To doubt, to discuss; (also with प्रति and सम्.) With सम and आङ्, To instruct, to teach. With सम and नि, To place or have near at hand. In the causal with उप, To understand.
धा m. (-धाः) 1 A possessor, a holder, a container, &c. 2 A name of BRAHMĀ. 3 VṚHASPATI. E. धा to have, affix विच्.
धाक: धाक m. (-कः) 1 An ox. 2 Food. 3 Boiled rice. 4 A post. E. धा to have or hold, Uṇādi affix क.
धाटी: धाटी f. (-टी) Advancing towards or confronting an enemy.
धाणक: धाणक m. (-कः) A weight of gold, a coin of that metal, the division of a Dīnāra. E. धा to contain, Uṇādi affix आणक.
धातकी: धातकी f. (-की) A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. धा to have, affix ण्वुल्, तन् inserted.
धातु: धातु m. (-तुः) 1 A principle or humour of the body, as phlegm, wind, and bile. 2 Any constituent part of the body, as blood, flesh, &c. 3 A primary or elementary substance, viz. earth, water, fire, air, and Ākāśa or atmosphere. 4 The property of a primary element, odour, flavour, colour, touch, and sound. 5 An organ of sense. 6 A mineral, a fossil. 7 A metal. 8 A grammatical root; in Sanskrit this radical performs no other office, and cannot be used as a word without undergoing some change. E. धा to possess, to contain, (life, substance, &c.) तुन् aff.
धातुकाशीश: धातुकाशीश n. (-शं) Red sulphate of iron. E. धातु mineral, and काशीश the green sulphate.
धातुघ्न: धातुघ्न n. (-घ्नं) Sour gruel, prepared from the fermentation of rice water. E. धातु chyle, and घ्न destroying; also similar compounds.
धातुनाशन: धातुनाशन n. (-नं) Sour gruel: see the last. E. धातु, and नाशन injuring.
धातुप: धातुप m. (-पः) The alimentary juice or chyle. E. धातु an essential constituent of the body, and प what cherishes.
धातुपुष्पिका: धातुपुष्पिका f. (-का) A plant: see धातृपुष्पिका; also धातुपुष्पी.
धातुभृत्: धातुभृत् m. (-त्) 1 A mountain. 2 A robust man. mfn. (-भृत्) Promoting the animal secretions. E. धातु a mineral, and भृत् what contains.
धातुमाक्षिक: धातुमाक्षिक n. (-कं) A mineral substance, a sulphuret of iron. E. धातु mineral, and माक्षिक the same substance.
धातुमारिणी: धातुमारिणी f. (-णी) Borax. E. धातु a metal, मृ to perish, in the causal form, णिनि and ङीप् affixes; the borate of soda is generally used in India as a flux.
धातुराजक: धातुराजक m. (-कः) Semen, the seminal fluid. E. धातु animal fluid, &c. राज chief, कन् added.
धातुवल्लभ: धातुवल्लभ n. (-भं) Borax. E. धातु, and वल्लभ friend, a flux.
धातुवादिन्: धातुवादिन् m. (-दी) An assayer, a miner, a mineralogist. E. धातु a mineral, वद to speak or describe, affix णिनि.
धातुवैरिन्: धातुवैरिन् m. (-री) Sulphur. E. धातु a metal, and वैरिन् an enemy; tarnishing metallic lustre, &c.
धातुशेखर: धातुशेखर m. (-रः) Green sulphate of iron, or green vitriol. E. धातु a mineral, and शेखर crest or chief.
धातूपल: धातूपल m. (-लः) Chalk. E. धातु a mineral, and उपला stone.
धातृ: धातृ m. (-ता) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 A title of VIṢṆU. 3 A father, a parent. f. (-त्री) 1 A mother. 2 A foster-mother, a nurse. 3 The earth. 4 Emblick myrobalan. mfn. (-ता-ती-तृ) 1 A cherisher, a protector, fostering, nourishing. 2 Having, containing, possessing, a possessor, &c. E. धा to have, to nourish, &c. affix तृच्.
धातृपुत्त्र: धातृपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A saint, also called SANATKUMĀRA. E. धातृ BRAHMĀ, and पुत्त्र the son.
धातृपुष्पिका: धातृपुष्पिका f. (-का) A tree, (Grislea tomentosa, Rox.) E. धातृ cherishing, पुष्प a flower, ङीष् added, धातृपुष्पी and कन् added; also without the pleonasm, धातृपुष्पी, f. (-ष्पी).
धात्रिका: धात्रिका f. (-का) Emblick myrobalan. E. कन् added to धात्री.
धात्रीपुत्त्र: धात्रीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 An actor. 2 A foster-brother. E. धात्री a nurse, and पुत्त्र a son.
धात्रीफल: धात्रीफल n. (-लं) The fruit of the emblic myrobalan. E. धात्री Phyllanthus emblica, and फल fruit.
धात्रेयी: धात्रेयी f. (-यी) 1 A sort of confidante, a foster-sister so employed. 2 A wet-nurse. E. धातृ a nurse, ढक् affix, fem. affix ङीप्.
धाना: धाना f. plu. (-नाः) 1 Fried barley or rice. sin. (-नः) 1 Coriander, (Coriandrum sativum.) 2 Grain fried, and reduced to powder. 3 A bud, a shoot. E. धा to nourish, न Uṇādi aff.
धानाका: धानाका f. plu. (-काः) Fried barley or rice. E. धाना as above, कन् added.
धानाचूर्ण: धानाचूर्ण n. (-र्णं) The meal or flour of fried barley, rice, &c. E. धाना fried grain, चूर्ण powder, dust.
धानी: धानी f. (-नी) 1 Coriander. 2 A granary, a receptacle. 3 The site of a habitation. 4 The name of a river. 5 What has or contains, used in composition, as राजधानी a royal capital, having the king's presence; मत्स्यधानी a net, &c. E. धा to have, affix युच्, fem. affix ङीप्.
धानुष्क: धानुष्क m. (-ष्कः) A bowyer, an archer. E. धनुस् a bow, ठञ् affix. f. (-ष्का) A tree, (Achyranthes aspera). E. धनुष्क an archer, अण् affix, and fem. affix टाप्, or धनुस् a bow, ठन् aff.
धानुष्य: धानुष्य m. (-ष्यः) A bambu. E. धनुस् as above, यञ् aff.
धानेय: धानेय n. (-यः) Coriander, (Coriandrum sativum.) E. धन grain, &c. aff. ढक्; also with कन् added, धानेयक.
धान्य: धान्य n. (-न्यं) 1 Corn in general, but especially rice, (Oriza sativa.) 2 Coriander. 3 A measure equal to four Sesamum seeds. E. धा to nourish (mankind), Uṇādi affix यत्, and नुट् augment.
धान्यक: धान्यक n. (-कं) Coriander, (C. sativum.) E. कन् added to धान्य; also धन्याक and धान्याक.
धान्यकल्क: धान्यकल्क n. (-ल्कं) Bran, chaff, straw. E. धान्य, and कल्क dirt or sediment.
धान्यकोष्ठक: धान्यकोष्ठक n. (-कं) A granary, a basket, a cupboard or small shed of matting, &c. for keeping rice. E. धान्य rice, कोष्ठ a granary, and कन् added.
धान्यचमस: धान्यचमस m. (-सः) Rice flattened by threshing after it has been steeped, and fried in the husk. E. धान्य grain, and चमस a sort of cake.
धान्यधेनु: धान्यधेनु f. (-नुः) A heap of rice to be presented to Brahmans. E. धान्य, and धेनु a cow.
धान्यमाय: धान्यमाय m. (-यः) A corn-seller, &c. E. धान्य grain, मा to measure, अण् aff.
धान्यराज: धान्यराज m. (-जः) Barley. E. धान्य, and राजा king.
धान्यवत्: धान्यवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Abounding in corn, having abundance of it. E. धान्य, and मतुप् poss. aff.
धान्यवर्द्धन: धान्यवर्द्धन n. (-नं) Lending grain at interest; receiving a usurious return for a loan of seed corn supplied to the peasants. E. धान्य corn, वर्द्धन increasing.
धान्यवीज: धान्यवीज n. (-जं) Coriander. E. धान्य, and वीज seed.
धान्यवीर: धान्यवीर m. (-रः) A sort of pulse, (Phaseolus max.) E. धान्य, and वीर best.
धान्यशीर्षक: धान्यशीर्षक n. (-कं) The ear or spike of corn. E. धान्य, with शीर्षक the top or head.
धान्यसङ्ग्रह: धान्यसङ्ग्रह m. (-हः) A store or magazine of grain. E. धान्य, and सङ्ग्रह collection.
धान्यसार: धान्यसार m. (-रः) Grain after threshing. E. धान्य corn, and सार essence.
धान्याक: धान्याक n. (-कं) Coriander. E. अण् added to धन्याक.
धान्याचल: धान्याचल m. (-लः) A pile of grain for presentation to Brahmans. E. धान्य, and अचल a mountain.
धान्याम्ल: धान्याम्ल n. (-म्लं) Sour gruel made of the fermentation of rice water. E. धान्य rice, and अम्ल sour.
धान्यारि: धान्यारि m. (-रिः) A rat. E. धान्य, and अरि a foe.
धान्यार्थ: धान्यार्थ m. (-र्थः) Wealth in rice or grain. E. धान्य, and अर्थ wealth.
धान्यास्थि: धान्यास्थि n. (-स्थि) Grain after threshing. E. धान्य, and अस्थि a bone.
धान्योत्तम: धान्योत्तम n. (-मं) Rice. E. धान्य, and उत्तम best.
धामन्: धामन् n. (-म) 1 The body. 2 A house, a dwelling. 3 Dignity, consequence, eminence. 4 Spirit, pride, especially martial pride, heroism. 5 Light, splendour, radiance. 6 A ray of light. 7 A place, a spot, a country. 8 Birth. E. धा to contain, (life, a tenant, &c.) and मनिन् aff.
धामनिधि: धामनिधि m. (-धिः) The sun. E. धाम light, निधि a nest or receptacle.
धामनी: धामनी f. (-नी) Any tubular vessel of the body: see धमनी.
धामवत्: धामवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Splendid, luminous. 2 Eminent, exalted, illustrious. 3 Heroic. E. धामन्, and मतुप् aff.
धामार्गव: धामार्ग्गव n. (-वः) 1 A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.) 2 A plant, a sort of Ghosha, with white flowers. E. धामन् a dwelling, मार्ग a road, ब to go or approach, affix क, deriv. irr.
धामार्ग्गव: धामार्ग्गव n. (-वः) 1 A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.) 2 A plant, a sort of Ghosha, with white flowers. E. धामन् a dwelling, मार्ग a road, ब to go or approach, affix क, deriv. irr.
धाय: धाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Having, possessing, or who has or possesses. E. धा to have, ण aff.
धायस्: धायस् mfn. (-याः-याः-यः) An upholder. E. धा to have, &c. असुन् Uṇādi affix; also with a final vowel added, धायस.
धाय्य: धाय्य m. (-य्यः) A Purohita or family priest. f. (-य्या) A prayer for exciting fire, upon the addition of fuel. E. irregularly derived from धी to contain, with ण्यत् aff.
धार: धार n. (-रं) Water derived from rain. m. (-रः) 1 A sort of stone. 2 Debt. 3 Slight sprinkling rain. 4 Frost. 5 End, bound, a line or limit. 6 A deep place, a depth. f. (-रा) 1 A horse's pace, as the trot, canter, &c. 2 The van of an army. 3 The sharp edge of a sword or any cutting instrument. 4 The flowing, running, oozing, or distilling, &c. of any liquid, the motion of a fluid, stream, current, &c. 5 Offspring. 6 A leak, a flaw, a hole in a pitcher, &c. 7 Excellence. 8 The wheel of a carriage. 9 A garden wall or fence, a hedge, &c. 10 The edge of a mountain. 11 Quantity, multitude. 12 A heavy shower falling in large drops, or hail. 13 Fame. 14 Likeness. 15 Custom, usage. 16 The capital of BHOJA. 17 Pouring a stream of water upon an image to get rid of a fever. E. धृ to fall, to uphold, &c. in the causal form, and अङ् and टाप् affs.
धारक: धारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what holds or contains, a vessel or receptacle of any kind. m. (-कः) A water pot. E. धृ to have, ण्वुल् aff.
धारण: धारण n. (-णं) Holding, having, keeping, maintaining. f. (-णा) 1 Continuance in rectitude, keeping in the right way. 2 Fortitude, firmness, steadiness, resolution. 3 A particular religious exercise; keeping the mind collected, the breath suspended, and all natural wants restrained; steady, immoveable abstraction. 4 Mental retention, memory. 5 Understanding, intellect. 6 Believing, conviction. 7 Certainty, conclusion. 8 Positive precept or injunction. 9 Debt. f. (-णी) 1 Any tubular vessel of the body. 2 A mystical verse or charm, or collection of such verses, among the Bauddhas. 3 A row or line. E. धृ to hold, (purpose, intent, virtue, &c.) affix ल्युट् or युच्.
धारणक: धारणक m. (-कः) A debtor. E. धारण a debt, कन् aff.
धारणीय: धारणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be held or retained, to be adhered to. E. धृ to hold, अनीयर् aff.
धारय: धारय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Who or what has or possesses. E. धृ to have, causal form, श aff.
धारयत्: धारयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Having, possessing. 2 Acquainted with, versed in. 3 Holding as doctrine, believing, maintaining. E. धृ to have, शतृ aff.
धारयित्री: धारयित्री f. (-त्री) The earth. E. धृ to contain, in the causal form, तृच् aff.
धाराकदम्बक: धाराकदम्बक m. (-कः) A sort of Kadamba tree.
धाराङ्कुर: धाराङ्कुर m. (-रः) 1 Thin rain. 2 Hail. 3 Advancing before an army by way of defiance to an enemy. E. धारा rain, and अङ्कुर shoot or sprout.
धाराङ्ग: धाराङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A sword, a scimitar. 2 A place of pilgrimage. E. धारा the edge of a sword, &c. and अङ्ग body.
धाराट: धाराट m. (-टः) 1 The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) 2 A horse. 3 A cloud. 4 A furious elephant. E. धारा rain, &c. अट who goes.
धाराध्वनि: धाराध्वनि f. (-निः) The sound of falling rain or of the flowing of any fluid. E. धारा, and ध्वनि sound.
धाराधर: धाराधर m. (-रः) 1 A cloud. 2 A sword. E. धारा rain or an edge, and धर what has.
धारायन्त्र: धारायन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A scent bottle, a sprinkling vase or ewer, a sort of censer. E. धारा, and यन्त्र an instrument.
धारावनि: धारावनि m. (-निः) Air, wind. E. धारा thin rain, वन to sound, affix इ.
धाराविष: धाराविष m. (-षः) A crooked sword, a scimitar, a sabre. E. धारा, and विष poison; whose edge is as fatal as venom.
धाराश्रु: धाराश्रु n. (-श्रु) A flood of tears. E. धारा, and अश्रु a tear.
धारासम्पात: धारासम्पात m. (-तः) A hard shower, a heavy fall of rain. E. धारा rain, सम् implying quantity or accumulation, and पात falling.
धारासार: धारासार m. (-रः) A heavy fall of rain, a large drop or shower. E. धारा, and आसार sprinkling.
धारिणी: धारिणी f. (-णी) 1 The earth. 2 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) E. धृ, and घिणुन् aff.
धारित: धारित n. (-तं) A horse's trot; also धारितकंः see धौरितकं.
धारिन्: धारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि 1 Having, holding, keeping, possessing. 2 Edged. m. (-री) A sort of tree: see पीलु. E. धारा an edge, &c. इनि aff.
धारु: धारु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) Who drinks or sucks, a drinker, a sucker. E. धे to drink, रु affix, form special.
धार्तराष्ट्र: धार्त्तराष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) 1 A sort of goose, with black legs and bill. 2 A kind of snake. 3 DURYODHANA or any other descendant of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA. E. धृतराष्ट्र the name of a king or a bird, &c. and अण् affix of descent.
धार्त्तराष्ट्र: धार्त्तराष्ट्र m. (-ष्ट्रः) 1 A sort of goose, with black legs and bill. 2 A kind of snake. 3 DURYODHANA or any other descendant of DHṚTARĀṢṬRA. E. धृतराष्ट्र the name of a king or a bird, &c. and अण् affix of descent.
धार्मिक: धार्म्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Virtuous, pious, just. E. धर्म्म virtue, affix ठञ्.
धार्म्मिक: धार्म्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Virtuous, pious, just. E. धर्म्म virtue, affix ठञ्.
धार्य: धार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 To be born or upheld, to be contained, &c. 2 To be kept or detained. 3 To be determined. E. धृ to hold, ण्यत् aff.
धार्य्य: धार्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) 1 To be born or upheld, to be contained, &c. 2 To be kept or detained. 3 To be determined. E. धृ to hold, ण्यत् aff.
धार्यमाण: धार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being held, maintained, &c. E. धृ to uphold, pass. v. शानच् aff.
धार्य्यमाण: धार्य्यमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being held, maintained, &c. E. धृ to uphold, pass. v. शानच् aff.
धार्यमाणत्व: धार्य्यमाणत्व n. (-त्वं) Property. E. त्व added to the last.
धार्य्यमाणत्व: धार्य्यमाणत्व n. (-त्वं) Property. E. त्व added to the last.
धार्ष्ट्य: धार्ष्ट्य n. (-र्ष्ट्यं) Boldness, confidence, arrogance. E. धृष्टि bold, and ष्यञ् aff.
धाव: धाव (उ) धावु r. 1st cl. (धावति-ते) 1 To go or move. 2 To run. 3 To cleanse. 4 To be clean or pure. With अनु, 1 To know. 2 To run after. With अभि prefixed, To approach, to come before. With आङ्, To alight. With परि, To run fast. With वि, To shed or sprinkle. With सम् and उग्र, To run to meet.
धावक: धावक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Running, going, swift, expeditious. 2 Cleaning, what cleans or cleanses. E. धाव to go, वुन् aff.
धावत्: धावत् mfn. (-वन्-वन्ती-वत्) Running, going quickly. E. धाव to go, शतृ aff.
धावन: धावन n. (-नं) 1 Going, motion. 2 Cleansing, purifying. f. (-निः) or (-नी) A sort of creeping plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides.) E. धाव to go, to cleanse, affix ल्युट् or अनि fem. affix ङीप्.
धावनिका: धावनिका f. (-का) A prickly nightshade: see कण्टकारी. E. कन् added to धावनी, implying similitude.
धावित: धावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Purified, clean, cleansed. 2 Gone, gone or run away. 3 Run to, advanced to or against. E. धाव to clean, affix क्त, with इट् augment, or without the augment धौत.
धासस्: धासस् m. (-साः) A mountain. E. धा to uphold, Uṇādi affix असुन् and षुट् augment; the word is considered as peculiar to the Vedas.
धि: धि r. 6th cl. (धियति) To have or hold, to keep, to possess. 5th cl. (धिनोति) 1 To satisfy. 2 To go, to move.
धिक्: धिक् ind. An interjection of reproach or menace, (fie, shame, &c.) E. धक्क to annihilate, डिक् aff.
धिक्कार: धिक्कार m. (-रः) Disrespect, reproach, censure, contempt. E. धिक् fie, and कार making.
धिक्कृत: धिक्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cursed. 2 Reproached, reviled, censured, condemned. E. धिक् fie, and कृत made.
धिक्क्रिया: धिक्क्रिया f. (-या) Reproach. E. धिक् fie, and क्रिया making.
धिक्पारुष्य: धिक्पारुष्य n. (-ष्यं) Excessive abuse. E. धिक्, and पारुष्य violence.
धिक्ष: धिक्ष r. 1st cl. (धिक्षते) 1 To kindle. 2 To be weary. 3 To live.
धिग्वण: धिग्वण m. (-णः) A man of a low caste sprung from a Brahman, and a female of the tribe called Ayogava.
धिग्दण्ड: धिग्दण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Reprimand, censure. E. धिक्, and दण्ड punishment.
धिप्सु: धिप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Deceptive, wishing to trick or deceive. E. दम्भ to cheat, desid. v. उ aff.
धियाम्पति: धियाम्पति m. (-तिः) 1 A Jina or Jaina deified saint. 2 The soul. E. धी the understanding, in the seventh case, and पति master.
धिव: धिव (इ,) धिवि r. 1st and 5th cl. (धिनोति) 1 To please, to satisfy. 2 To be pleased or satisfied. 3 To go or approach: this verb takes उ, and substitutes अ for the final, whence its unusual form for the first class, in the instance given.
धिष: धिष r. 3rd cl. (दिधष्टि) To emit sound.
धिषण: धिषण m. (-णः) 1 A name of VṚHASPATI. 2 Any Guru or spiritual preceptor. f. (-णा) The understanding, the intellect. E. धृष to be presumptuous, Uṇādi affix क्यु, and धिष substituted for the root.
धिष्ण्य: धिष्ण्य n. (-ष्ण्यं) 1 A place, a spot, a country. 2 A house. 3 A star, an asterism. 4 Fire. 5 Power, strength. m. (-ष्ण्यः) A name of AGNI, the deity of fire. 2 A name of ŚUKRA, regent of VENUS. E. धृष to be proud or overbearing, deriv. irr.; the word is also written धिष्ट्य or धिष्ठ्य.
धी: धी (ओ ङ) ओ धीङ् r. 4th cl. (धीयते) 1 To contain, to hold. 2 To slight, to disregard or despise. 3 To accomplish. With अन्तर्, To disappear, to become invisible.
धी f. (-धीः) Understanding, intellect. E. ध्यै to meditate, affix क्विप्, the final diphthong rejected, and the semi-vowel changed to its congener इ, which becomes long.
धीत: धीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Drank, sucked. E. धे to drink, participial affix क्त, and form irr.
धीति: धीति f. (-तिः) Thirst. E. धे to drink, affix क्तिन्, and the radical vowel changed to ई.
धीदा: धीदा f. (-दा) 1 A virgin, a maiden. 2 Understanding, intellect.
धीन्द्रिय: धीन्द्रिय n. (-यं) An intellectual organ, as the mind, the eye, the ear, the nose, the tongue, and skin. E. धी the intellect, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense in general.
धीमत्: धीमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Sensible, wise, learned. m. (-मान्) A name of VṚHASPATI, the preceptor of the gods. E. धी wisdom, understanding, मतुप् possess. aff.
धीर: धीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Wise, sensible, learned. 2 Firm, steady, consistent, determined. 3 Cool, collected. 4 Head-strong, selfwilled, uncontrollable. 5 Lazy, dull, slow. 6 Strong, powerful. 7 Well behaved, decorous, decent. 8 Gentle, steady, (as a breeze.) 9 Deep, (as a sound.) m. (-रः) 1 A name of BALI, a celebrated prince. 2 The ocean. mn. (-रः-रं) Saffron. f. (-रा) 1 A drug; also काकोली. 2 A woman who, although jealous of a husband or lover, suppresses all expression of resentment in his presence. E. धी understanding, रा to possess, क affix; or धी with ईर to go to, affix अण्; or धी to possess, क्तन् Uṇādi aff.
धीरत्व: धीरत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Firmness, fortitude. 2 The feminine property of suppressing violent expression of jealousy. E. धीर firm, steady, affix त्व; also with तल् affix धीरता.
धीरप्रशान्त: धीरप्रशान्त n. (-न्तं) The hero of a poem or play who unites all good qualities. E. धीर, and प्रशान्त calm.
धीरललित: धीरललित m. (-तः) The hero of a poem or play, who is firm and brave, but reckless and inconsiderate. E. धीर, and ललित sportive.
धीरस्कन्द: धीरस्कन्द m. (-न्दः) A buffalo. E. धीर strong, स्कन्द a shoulder.
धीराधीरा: धीराधीरा f. (-रा) A mistress or wife, who having cause for jealousy, pursues a middle conduct between the suppression and expression of resentment. E. धीरा, and अधीरा joined.
धीरोदात्त: धीरोदात्त m. (-त्तः) The hero of a poem or play whose characteristics are benevolence and fortitude. E. धीर, and उदात्त liberal.
धीरोद्धत: धीरोद्धत m. (-तः) The hero of a poem or play who is deficient in magnanimity. E. धीर, and उद्धत haughty.
धीवन्: धीवन् m. (-वा) 1 A brazier. 2 A fisherman. E. धृ to hold, Uṇādi affix कनिन्, and ऋ changed to ई.
धीवर: धीवर m. (-रः) A fisherman. f. (-री) 1 A fisherman's wife. 2 A sort of harpoon for catching fish with. E. धी to hold or gain, (fish,) Uṇādi affix ष्वरच्.
धीशक्ति: धीशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) An intellectual faculty or power of the understanding, as attention, comprehension, &c. E. धी the intellect, and शक्ति power.
धीसख: धीसख m. (-खः) 1 A counsellor, an adviser, a minister. 2 A tutor or friend. E. धी the understanding, and सखि a friend.
धीसचिव: धीसचिव m. (-वः) 1 A counsellor, a minister. 2 A friendly or prudent adviser. E. धी the intellect, and सचिव a friend.
धु: धु (ञ) धुञ् r. 7th cl. (धुनोति धुनुते) To shake, to agitate: see धू.
धु f. (धुः) Shaking, trembling. E. धु to shake, क्विप् aff.
धुक्ष: धुक्ष r. 1st cl. (धुक्षते) 1 To kindle. 2 To be weary. 3 To live.
धुत: धुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Abandoned, deserted, left. 2 Shaken, agitated, (as leaves by wind, &c.) E. धु to shake, affix क्त.
धुतपाप: धुतपाप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Purified from sin. E. धुत shaken, पाप sin.
धुनन: धुनन n. (-नं) Shaking, agitation. E. धु to shake, affix ल्यु; also धूनन, &c.
धुनान: धुनान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shaking, agitating. E. धु to shake, शानच् aff.
धुनि: धुनि f. (-निः) A river; see the next.
धुनी: धुनी f. (-नी) A river. E. धु to go, affix नुक्, fem. affix ङीप्; the affix is sometimes considered as निक्, leaving नि, which makes धुनि ut sup.
धुनीनाथ: धुनीनाथ m. (-थः) The ocean. E. धुनी, and नाथ lord.
धुन्धुमार: धुन्धुमार m. (-रः) 1 The name of a sovereign; also named Kuvalayāśva. 2 An insect, (Coccinella.) 3 The smoke of a house. 4 A house lizard (?) E. धूम smoke reiterated, ऋ to go, affix अण्, deriv. irr.
धुन्वत्: धुन्वत् mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वन्ती-न्वत्) Shaking, agitating. E. धु to shake, शतृ aff.
धुन्वान: धुन्वान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shaking, agitating. E. धु to shake, शानच् aff.
धुर्: धुर् f. (-धूः) 1 The fore part of a carriage, the pole or the part where the yoke is fixed. 2 Agitation, trembling. 3 Reflection, recollection. 4 A spark of fire. 5 A burthen, a load. 6 A part, a portion. 7 Wealth. 8 A name of the Ganges. E. धुर्ब्ब to hurt, affix क्विप्, and व rejected; also with टाप् added, धुरा.
धुरन्धर: धुरन्धर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Bearing a burthen. 2 Bearing, (figuratively,) laden with good qualities, heavy duties, &c. m. (-रः) 1 A beast of burthen. 2 A man of business. 3 A tree, (Grislea tomentosa.) E. धुर् a burthen, and धृ to have, affix खञ्.
धुरा: धुरा f. (-रा) A burthen, a load. E. धुर्व्व to hurt, affixes क and टाप्.
धुरीण: धुरीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Bearing, (as a burthen.) 2 Charged with, abounding with, (qualities, duties, &c.) m. (-णः) 1 A beast of burthen. 2 A man of business. E. धुर् a burthen, ख aff.
धुरीय: धुरीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Fit for a load, suited to a burthen. 2 Charged with important duties. m. (-यः) 1 A beast of burthen. 2 A man of business. E. धुर्, and छ aff.
धुर्य: धुर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Fit for a burthen, adapted to it, &c. m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A beast of burthen. 2 A minister, a charge d'affaires. 3 A horse. E. धुर् a burthen, यत् aff.
धुर्य्य: धुर्य्य mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं) Fit for a burthen, adapted to it, &c. m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A beast of burthen. 2 A minister, a charge d'affaires. 3 A horse. E. धुर् a burthen, यत् aff.
धुर्व: धुर्व्व (इ) धुर्व्वी r. 1st cl. (धुर्व्वति) To kill or hurt.
धुर्व्व: धुर्व्व (इ) धुर्व्वी r. 1st cl. (धुर्व्वति) To kill or hurt.
धुर्वह: धुर्व्वह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Bearing a load, a burthen. m. (-हः) 1 A beast of burthen. 2 A minister, a charge d'affaires. E. धुर्, and वह who bears; also धुरावह.
धुर्व्वह: धुर्व्वह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Bearing a load, a burthen. m. (-हः) 1 A beast of burthen. 2 A minister, a charge d'affaires. E. धुर्, and वह who bears; also धुरावह.
धुवका: धुवका f. (-का) The introductory stanza to a song, forming afterwards the burthen of each verse. E. धू to agitate, अक Uṇādi aff.
धुवन: धुवन m. (-नः) A title of AGNI. E. धू to agitate, affix युच्.
धुवित्र: धुवित्र n. (-त्रं) A sort of fan made of deer skin, and used especially to excite a sacrificial fire. E. धू to agitate, इत्र affix; also धवित्र.
धुस्तुर: धुस्तुर m. (-रः) Thorn apple, (Datura fastuosa:) see the next.
धुस्तूर: धुस्तूर m. (-रः) Thorn apple, (Datura fastuosa.) E. धूष to make handsome, affix क्विप्, तूर् to be mischievous, affix क्; elegant but deleterious: the vowels are also both made short, as धुस्तुर, or both remain long, as in धूस्तूर; also written धुत्तूर.
धू: धू (ञ) धूञ् r. 5th cl. (धूनोति धूनुते) r. 6th cl. (धूवति) r. 9th cl. (धुनाति धुनीते) r. 1st and 10th cls. (धवति-ते धावयति-ते or धूनयति) To shake or agitate, to make tremble. With अव prefixed, 1 To abandon, to quit. 2 To perceive. With निर्, 1 To destroy. 2 To go or move. With वि, To make tremble or agitate.
धूक: धूक m. (-कः) 1 The air or wind. 2 A rogue, a cheat. 3 Time. E. धु to agitate, कन् Uṇādi affix, and the vowel made long.
धूक्ष: धूक्ष r. 1st cl. (धूक्षते) 1 To live. 2 To kindle. 3 To be distrest.
धूत: धूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Shaken, agitated. 2 Reproached, reviled. 3 Abandoned, deserted. 4 Judged, discriminated. f. (-ता) A wife. E. धू to shake, &c. affix क्त; this root also forms धून with the same aff.
धूतकल्मष: धूतकल्मष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Pure, free from sin. E. धूत shaken, पाप sin.
धून: धून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Distressed by heat or thirst. 2 Shaken, agitated. E. धू to shake, affix क्त, form irr.
धूनक: धूनक m. (-कः) Resin; it is sometimes read धूणक.
धूनन: धूनन n. (-नं) Shaking, agitating. E. धू to shake, affix ल्युट्.
धूनि: धूनि f. (-निः) Shaking, agitating. E. धू to agitate, affix क्तिन्, and त changed to न.
धूप: धूप r. 1st cl. (धूपायति) To heat. r. 10th cl. (धूपयति) 1 To speak. 2 To shine.
धूप m. (-पः) Incense, the aromatic vapour that proceeds from the combustion of any fragrant gum or resin, the use of which is authorized by scripture. E. धूप to heat, affix अच्.
धूपन: धूपन m. (-नः) 1 Resin. 2 Incense. E. धूप to heat, affix ल्यु.
धूपवृक्ष: धूपवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) A species of pine, (Pinus longifolia.) E. धूप incense or resin so used, and वृक्ष a tree; also with कन् added, धूपवृक्षक.
धूपाङ्ग: धूपाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Turpentine. E. धूप, and अङ्ग part.
धूपायित: धूपायित mn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Suffering pain or fatigue. 2 Incensed, perfumed with incense. E. धूप (to heat, &c.) affix क्त, आय inserted, or the passive form with the same aff.
धूपिका: धूपिका f. (-का) Mist, fog. E. धूप incense, कन् affix of resemblance, fem. form.
धूपित: धूपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Suffering pain or fatigue. 2 Scented, perfumed, incensed. E. धूप to heat, affix क्त.
धूम: धूम m. (-मः) 1 Smoke. 2 A saint. E. धूम to agitate, Uṇādi affix क्.
धूमकेतन: धूमकेतन m. (-नः) 1 KETU, the personified descending node. 2 Fire or its deity. E. धूम smoke, and केतन a symbol.
धूमकेतु: धूमकेतु m. (-तुः) 1 A comet or falling-star. 2 Fire. 3 The personified descending node. E. धूम smoke, and केतु a mark or symbol.
धूमध्वज: धूमध्वज m. (-जः) Fire. E. धूम smoke, and ध्वज a sign or symbol.
धूमप्रभा: धूमप्रभा f. (-भा) A division of hell, the hell of smoke. E. धूम, and प्रभा what shines.
धूममहिषी: धूममहिषी f. (-षी) Fog, mist. E. धूम smoke, महिषी a buffalo.
धूमयोनि: धूमयोनि m. (-निः) A cloud. E. धूम smoke, and योनि womb; what is engendered from smoke or vapour.
धूमल: धूमल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a purple colour. m. (-लः) Purple, a colour compounded of black and red. E. धूम smoke, and ल what is, being of the hue of smoke.
धूमसंहति: धूमसंहति f. (-तिः) A cloud or quantity of smoke. E. धूम, and संहति collection.
धूमसी: धूमसी f. (-सी) A cake of pulse steeped in water, and dried in the sun.
धूमाकार: धूमाकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Of the form or appearance of smoke. E. धूम, and आकार form.
धूमाभ: धूमाभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Of a purple colour. m. (-भः) Purple. E. धूम smoke, and आभ resembling; of a smoky hue.
धूमावलि: धूमावलि f. (-लिः) A wreath or cloud of smoke. E. धूम, and आवलि a line.
धूमिका: धूमिका f. (-का) Fog, vapour. E. धूम smoke, and कन् affix of resemblance.
धूमोर्णा: धूमोर्णा f. (-र्णा) The wife of YAMA. E. धूम smoke, and ऊर्ण wool; of a smoky hue, and woolly-headed, a Caffree Proserpine.
धूमोर्णापति: धूमोर्णापति m. (-तिः) YAMA, the ruler of the dead. E. धूमोर्णा as above, and पति husband.
धूम्या: धूम्या f. (-म्या) A quantity of smoke. E. धूम with य affix, implying aggregation.
धूम्याट: धूम्याट m. (-टः) The fork-tailed shrike. धूम्या much smoke, and अट who goes.
धूम्र: धूम्र mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं) Of a purple or smoky colour. m. (-म्रः) Purple; the colour; a compound of red and black. n. (-म्रं) Sin, vice, wickedness. E. धूम smoke, रा to get, affix क, deriv. irr.
धूम्रक: धूम्रक m. (-कः) A camel. E. धूम्र smoky, कन् affix; of a smoky or tawny hue.
धूम्रलोचन: धूम्रलोचन m. (-नः) A pigeon. E. धूम्र dark, लोचन the eye.
धूम्ररुच्: धूम्ररुच् mfn. (-रुक्) Of a purple colour. E. धूम्र, and रुच् to shine, affix क्विप्.
धूम्रवर्ण: धूम्रवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) Of a smoky hue. m. (-र्णः) Incense. f. (-र्णा) Flame, or one of the seven tongues of AGNI or fire. E. धूम्र smoky or purplish, and वर्णं colour.
धूम्राक्षि: धूम्राक्षि m. (-क्षिः) A pearl of a bad colour. E. धूम्र smoky, अक्षि an eye.
धूम्राट: धूम्राट m. (-टः) The fork-tailed shrike. E. धूम्र smoky, and अट who goes.
धूम्राभ: धूम्राभ m. (-भः) Air, wind. E. धूम्र smoky, आभ who shines.
धूम्रिका: धूम्रिका f. (-का) The Sisu tree. E. कन् added to धूम्र, fem. form.
धूयमान: धूयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Agitated, shaken. E. धू to shake, pass. v. शानच् aff.
धूर: धूर (ई,) धूरी r. 4th cl. (धूर्य्यते) 1 To kill or hurt. 2 To move or approach.
धूर्जटि: धूर्ज्जटि m. (-टिः) A name of ŚIVA. E. धुर् a burthen, and जटि a collection, from जट to collect, and इन् affix; who collects or bears the burthen of the three worlds.
धूर्ज्जटि: धूर्ज्जटि m. (-टिः) A name of ŚIVA. E. धुर् a burthen, and जटि a collection, from जट to collect, and इन् affix; who collects or bears the burthen of the three worlds.

धूर्वी: धूर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) The fore part or pole of a carriage. E. धुर्व्व to injure, affix अच् and ङीष्.
धूर्व्वी: धूर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) The fore part or pole of a carriage. E. धुर्व्व to injure, affix अच् and ङीष्.
धूलि: धूलि mf. (-लिः-लिः or -ली) 1 Dust. 2 A number. E. धू to agitate, affix लि.
धूलिका: धूलिका f. (-का) Fog or mist. E. धलि dust, कन् affix of resemblance; the dust of the atmosphere.
धूलिकुट्टिम: धूलिकुट्टिम n. (-मं) A mound, a rampart. E. धूलि dust or earth, and कुट्टिम prepared ground.
धूलिकेदार: धूलिकेदार m. (-रः) A mound, a rampart of earth. E. धूलि dust, and केदार a field.
धूलिगुच्छक: धूलिगुच्छक m. (-कः) The red vegetable powder thrown about at the spring festival called the Holī. E. धूलि dust, and गुच्छक a nosegay; also धूलिगुच्छ m. (-च्छः.)
धूलिध्वज: धूलिध्वज m. (-जः) Air or wind. E. धूलि dust, and ध्वज sign or symbol.
धूलीकदम्ब: धूलीकदम्ब m. (-म्बः) 1 A species of the Kadamba tree, (Nauclea cordifolia.) 2 Tila, a plant. 3 A tree: see वरुण (Tapia cratæva.) धूलीपटल: धूलीपटल m. (-लः) A cloud of dust. E. धूली, and पटल a heap.

धूस: धूस r. 10th cl. (धूसयति) To embellish, to make splendid or elegant.
धूसर: धूसर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Grey, of that colour. m. (-रः) 1 Grey, (the colour.) 2 A jackass. 3 An oilman. 4 A camel. 5 A pigeon. 6 Any thing of a grey tint. f. (-री) A female Kinnara or chorister of heaven. E. धू to agitate, (the mind,) सर Uṇādi aff.
धूसरच्छदा: धूसरछदा f. (-दा) A plant commonly Śvetarāsnā. E. धूसर grey, and छद a leaf, grey-leaved.

धृज: धृज r. 1st cl. (धर्जति) also (ई) धृजि r. 1st cl. (धृंजति) To go or move.
धृत्: धृत् mfn. (-धृत्) Who has, holds, possesses, &c. E. धृ to have, क्विप् aff.
धृत: धृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Possessed, held, contained. 2 Cherished, supported. 3 Stood, stayed, standing. 4 Alighted, gone down. 5 Placed. 6 Considered, weighed. E. धृ to hold, and क्त aff.
धृतकार्मुकेषु: धृतकार्मुकेषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Armed with bow and arrow. E. धृत, कार्म्मुक a bow, and इषु an arrow.
धृतपट: धृतपट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Covered or overspread with a cloth, &c. E. धृत, and पट a cloth.

(-ष्ट्रः) A proper name; DHṚTARĀṢṬRA, the father of DURYODHANA, and uncle of the Pāṇḍu princes. 2 A good king. 3 A Nāga or serpent of the lower regions. 4 A kind of bird, perhaps a sort of goose: see धार्त्तराष्ट्र. f. (-री) A goose, the female bird only. E. धृत possessed, cherished, (by whom,) राष्ट्र a region.
धृतवत्: धृतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Held, was holding. 2 Having taken or conveyed. E. धृ to hold, क्तवतु aff.
धृतहेति: धृतहेति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Armed. E. धृत, and हेति a weapon.
धृतात्मन्: धृतात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Firm, steady, calm, collected. E. धृत, and आत्मन् self.
धृताम्भस्: धृताम्भस् mfn. (-म्भाः-म्भाः-म्भः) Full of water. E. धृत, and अम्भस् water.

धृतिमत्: धृतिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Firm, steady, calm. 2 Content. E. धृति, and मतुप् aff.
धृतिमुष्: धृतिमुष् mfn. (मुट्) Discomposing, agitating. E. धृति firmness, and मुष् what steals.
धृत्वन्: धृत्वन् m. (-त्वा) 1 Virtue, morality. 2 A Brahman. 3 The sea. 4 The sky. 5 A clever man. 6 A name of VIṢṆU. E. धृ to hold, क्वनिप् affix, तुक् augment.
धृत्वरी: धृत्वरी f. (-री) The earth. E. धृ to hold, क्वरप् affix, and तुक augment.

ध्मात: ध्मात mfn. (-तः-ता-तुं) 1 Inflamed, excited. 2 Blown into or up, inflated. 3 Blown by a bellows, (a fire, &c.) E. ध्मा to blow, &c. affix क्त.
ध्मामन्: ध्मामन् m. (-मा) 1 Measure. 2 Light. 3 Meditation. E. ध्मा to blow or breathe, Uṇādi affix मन्.

ध्यानीय: ध्यानीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be meditated upon. E. ध्यै to think, and अनीथर् aff.
ध्याम: ध्याम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Black. n. (-मं) 1 A fragrant grass. 2 A plant, (Artemisia.) E. ध्यै to think, मक् aff.

ध्यायत्: ध्यायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Thinking of, meditating upon. E. ध्य to think, शतृ aff.
ध्येय: ध्येय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be meditated or pondered. E. ध्यै to meditate, यत् aff.
ध्यै: ध्यै r. 1st cl. (ध्यायति) To recollect, to call to mind, to meditate, to think; with the preposition नि, to see, to look, to look out for.
ध्रज: ध्रज r. 1st cl. (ध्रजति) To go; also (इ) ध्रञ्जि r. 1st cl. (ध्रंजति) To go or move.
ध्रण: ध्रण r. 1st cl. (ध्रणति) To sound, as a drum or other instrument.
ध्रस: ध्रस r. 10th cl. (ध्रसयति) To throw or toss up. (उ) उध्रस r. 9th cl. (ध्रस्नाति) To glean: the root is by some authorities read उध्रस.
ध्राक्ष: ध्राक्ष (इ) ध्राक्षि r. 1st cl. (ध्रांक्षति) 1 To utter the sound of birds, or to crow, caw, &c. 2 To desire: see ध्वाक्ष.
ध्राख: ध्राख (ऋ) ध्राखृ r. 1st cl. (ध्राखति) 1 To be dry or arid. 2 To adorn. 3 To suffice, to be able or competent. 4 To refuse, to prevent.
ध्राघ: ध्राघ (ऋ) ध्राघृ r. 1st cl. (ध्राघते) To be able on competent.
ध्राजि: ध्राजि f. (-जिः) A whirlwind, a gale. E. ध्रज to go, इ Uṇādi affix, and the radical vowel made long.
ध्राड: ध्राड (ऋ) ध्राडृ r. 1st cl. (ध्राडति) To divide, to split, to cut or pierce.
ध्राडि: ध्राडि m. (-डिः) Gathering flowers. E. ध्राड to divide, affix इ.
ध्रिज: ध्रिज r. 1st cl. (ध्रेजति) To go or move.
ध्रियमाण: ध्रियमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Being held or sustained. 2 Being withheld, checked, suppressed, &c. E. धृ to hold, passive v. शानच् aff.
ध्रु: ध्रु r. 1st cl. (ध्रवति) r. 6th cl. (ध्रुवति) 1 To be firm or fixed. 2 To go or move.
ध्रुव: ध्रुव r. 6th cl. (ध्रुवति) 1 To stand firm. 2 To go or move.

ध्रुव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Eternal. 2 Fixed, stable, firm. 3 Continual, permanent. 4 Certain, ascertained. 5 Spread, extended. m. (-वः) 1 A name of BRAHMĀ. 2 ŚIVA. 3 VIṢṆU. 4 The polar star or north pole itself; in mythology, personified by DHRUVA, the son of UTTĀNAPĀDA, and grandson of the first MANU. 5 The pole of any great circle, particularly either of the celestial poles. 6 (In Astronomy,) The distance of a planet from the beginning of the sydereal zodiac. 7 Any epoch to which a computation of dates is referred. 8 One of the demigods called VASUS. 9 The trunk of a lopped tree. 10 The Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) 11 One of the twenty-seven astronomical Yogas, or the Yoga star of the twelfth lunar asterism, supposed to be β Leonis. 12 A sort of bird: see शराटि. n. (-वं) 1 Ascertainment, certainty. 2 Logie, reasoning, discussion. 3 Heaven. f. (-वा) 1 A sacrificial vase made in the shape of the Indian fig leaf, and of the wood of the Flacourtia sapida. 2 A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) 3 A small tree from the fibres of which bow strings are made: see मूर्व्वा. 4 The introductory stanza of a song: it is distinct from the verses of the song, after each of which it is again repeated as a burden or chorus. 5 A virtuous woman. E. ध्रु to be fixed, affix अच्.
ध्रुवक: ध्रुवक m. (-कः) 1 The trunk of a lopped tree. 2 Longitude. f. (-का) The introductory stanza and burden of a song: see ध्रुवा. E. कन् added to the preceding.
ध्रू: ध्रू r. 6th cl. (ध्रुवति) 1 To be firm, to stand fast. 2 To go or move.
ध्रेक: ध्रेक (ऋ) ध्रेकृ r. 1st cl. (ध्रेकते) 1 To sound. 2 To grow or increase. 3 To be exhilarated or elevated with joy. 4 To manifest elevation or hilarity by noise.
ध्रै: ध्रै r. 1st cl. (ध्रायति) To be satisfied or pleased.
ध्रौव्य: ध्रौव्य n. (-व्यं) Firmness, fixedness. 2 Duration. E. ध्रुव, and ष्यञ् aff.
ध्वंस: ध्वंस (उ) ध्वंसु r. 1st cl. (ध्वंसते) 1 To fall down. 2 To reduce to powder. 3 To go.
ध्वंस m. (-सः) Loss, destruction. f. (-सी) A mote in a sun-beam. E. ध्वंस to fall, affix अच्.
ध्वंसन: ध्वंसन n. (-नं) 1 Perishing, dying. 2 Loss, destruction. 3 Going. 4 Falling. E. ध्वंस to fall down, affix ल्युट्.
ध्वंसित: ध्वंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Lost, destroyed. 2 Vexed, incensed. E. ध्वंस to fall down, क्त aff.
ध्वंसिन्: ध्वंसिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) 1 Destructive, destroying. 2 Suffering loss, perishing. m. (-सी) A Pilu tree, said to grow in mountainous districts. E. ध्वंस to fall, and इनि aff.
ध्वज: ध्वज r. 1st cl. (ध्वजति) also (इ) ध्वजि r. 1st cl. (ध्वंजति) To go, to move.

ध्वज mn. (-जः-जं) 1 A flag or banner. 2 A mark, a sign or symbol. 3 The penis. 4 The upper part of a skull carried on a stick, as a penance for the murder of a Brahman. 5 A house situated to the east of any object. 6 A flag-staff. 7 (In Prosody,) An Iambic. m. (-जः) 1 A distiller. 2 Pride. 3 Hypocrisy, fraud. E. ध्वज to go, affix अच्.
ध्वजद्रुम: ध्वजद्रुम m. (-मः) The palm tree. E. ध्वज a banner, द्रुम a tree.
ध्वजप्रहरण: ध्वजप्रहरण m. (-णः) Air or wind. E. ध्वज a flag, and प्रहरण who seizes.
ध्वजभङ्ग: ध्वजभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 Impotence. 2 Fracture or fall of a banner. E. ध्वज, and भङ्ग breaking.
ध्वजवत्: ध्वजवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having a mark or sign. m. (-वान्) 1 An ensign, a standard-bearer. 2 A distiller, a vender of spirituous liquors. 3 A Brahman who having slain another, carries the skull of the murdered man with him to places of pilgrimage by way of penance. E. ध्वज as above, मतुप् aff.
ध्वजराजिन्: ध्वजराजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Bearing or displaying ensigns. E. ध्वज, and राज to shine, णिनि aff.
ध्वजांशुक: ध्वजांशुक m. (-कः) A flag. E. ध्वज, and अंशुक a cloth.
ध्वजिन्: ध्वजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Having a flag or sign, &c. m. (-जी) 1 A Brahman. 2 A mountain. 3 A car or carriage. 4 A snake. 5 A horse. 6 A peacock. 7 A distiller or vender of spirituous liquors. 8 A standard-bearer. 9 An armiger, one having an emblem or sign. f. (-नी) An army. E. ध्वज symbol, इनि aff.
ध्वजीकरण: ध्वजीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Raising a standard. 2 Taking an emblem, &c. 3 Making any thing a plea, or setting up as a claim or right. E. ध्वज, and करण making, च्चि augment.
ध्वजोत्थान: ध्वजोत्थान n. (-नं) The twelfth day of the light half of Bhādra, a festival in honour of INDRA. E. ध्वज a flag, and उत्थान elevating.
ध्वन: ध्वन r. 1st cl. (ध्वनति) r. 10th cl. (ध्वनयति ध्वानयति) To sound.
ध्वन m. (-नः) Sound. E. ध्वन to sound, अच् affix: see ध्वान.
ध्वनत्: ध्वनत् mfn. (-नन्-नन्ती-नत्) Sounding, making a noise. E. ध्वन to sound, शतृ aff.
ध्वनमोदिन्: ध्वनमोदिन् m. (-दी) The humble bee. E. ध्वन sound, and मोदिन् who delights.
ध्वनयत्: ध्वनयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Sounding, resounding, echoing with. E. ध्वन to sound, शतृ aff.
ध्वनि: ध्वनि m. (-निः) 1 Sound. 2 Figurative or poetical style. 3 The sound of a drum. E. ध्वन to sound, इ aff.
ध्वनिग्रह: ध्वनिग्रह m. (-हः) 1 The ear. 2 Hearing. E. ध्वनि sound, ग्रह the recipient.
ध्वनित: ध्वनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sounded, making a noise, as a drum, &c. 2 Poetical, figurative, rhetorically expressed. E. ध्वन to sound, affix क्त.
ध्वनिनाला: ध्वनिनाला f. (-ला) 1 The Vīṇā or lute. 2 A pipe, a fife. 3 A sort of trumpet. E. ध्वनि sound, and नाला a hollow tube.
ध्वनिविकार: ध्वनिविकार m. (-रः) Change of voice, through fear, grief, &c. E. ध्वनि sound, विकार change.
ध्वस्त: ध्वस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Fallen. 2 Destroyed, perished, lost. E. ध्वंस to fall, affix क्त.
ध्वाक्ष: ध्वाक्ष (इ) ध्वाक्षि r. 1st cl. (ध्वांक्षति) 1 To utter a cry peculiar to birds, as to croke, caw, &c. 2 To desire.
ध्वाङ्क्ष: ध्वाङ्क्ष m. (-ङ्क्षः) 1 Any aquatick bird, as a crane, a gull, &c. feeding upon fish. 2 A crow. 3 One of the Nāgas. 4 A beggar. f. (-ङ्क्षी) 1 A drug: see काकोली. 2 A female imp or fiend. E. ध्वाङ्क्ष to cry, affix अच्; it and its derivatives may also be read ध्माक्ष, &c.
ध्वाङ्क्षपुष्ट: ध्वाङ्क्षपुष्ट m. (-ष्टः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. E. ध्वाङ्क्ष a crow, and पुष्ट fostered.
ध्वाङ्क्षराविन्: ध्वाङ्क्षराविन् mfn. (-वी-विणी-वि) Having a voice like a crow. E. ध्वाङ्क्ष a crow, and रव sound, affix णिनि.
ध्वाङ्क्षाराति: ध्वाङ्क्षाराति m. (-तिः) An owl. E. ध्वाङ्क्ष a crow, and अराति an enemy.
ध्वाङ्क्षाली: ध्वाङ्क्षाली f. (-ली) A medicinal plant: see काकोली.
ध्वान: ध्वान n. (-नं) Sound in general. E. ध्वन to sound, घञ् aff.
ध्वान्त: ध्वान्त n. (-न्तं) Darkness. E. ध्वन to sound, क्त affix, deriv. irr.
ध्वान्तवित्त: ध्वान्तवित्त m. (-त्तः) The firefly. E. ध्वान्त darkness, and वित्त wealth.
ध्वान्तशात्रव: ध्वान्तशात्रव m. (-बः) 1 A sort of Cassia, (C. fistula.) 2 The sun or any luminous body. E. ध्वान्त darkness, and शात्रव averse to.
ध्वान्ताराति: ध्वान्ताराति m. (-तिः) The sun or any luminous body. E. ध्वान्त darkness, and अरानि an enemy.
ध्वान्तोन्मेष: ध्वान्तोन्मेष m. (-षः) The firefly. E. ध्वान्त darkness, and उन्मेष twinkling.
ध्वृ: ध्वृ r. 1st cl. (ध्वरति) 1 To bend, to make crooked. 2 To kill. 3 To describe. न
